patch_description: Crossover of the two programs: keeps the multi-candidate hexagonal-lattice constructor and the deterministic refinement (refine_layout) from the inspiration program, combined with the faster single-layout pipeline of the current program. Additionally adds more candidate row arrangements (e.g., 5,4,5,4,5,3 variants plus offset/expanded layouts where the lattice is stretched to fill the square) and slightly more refinement iterations to push the sum of radii higher, while keeping the Gauss-Seidel grow_radii feasibility guarantee. It returns the best candidate found, preserving the same interface (centers, radii, sum_radii).
